window: committer dates since 2026-10-25, snapshotted 2026-11-26T00:06:09Z (2026-11-25 19:06 local UTC-05)
method: GitHub commit search for the exact factory-droid[bot] co-author trailer.
Associated pull requests resolved through each commit's repository pull mapping.

For Content Upgrades, squash-merge commits without API pull associations were matched to merged PRs by embedded PR numbers or exact unique title matches; those inferred mappings are labelled on each commit.
Open and closed-unmerged pull requests created in the same window scanned separately because unmerged branch commits are not reliably indexed in default-branch commit search.
limitations: This is provenance, not a productivity score: it does not measure hours, cost, model mix, or how much of a change was human versus agent.
A Factory-attributed commit is not proof of sole authorship; several pull requests mix Factory, Devin, human, dependency-bot, and merge commits.

The original commit-to-PR API does not associate squash-result commits with their source PRs. The 22 Content Upgrades mappings are inference backed by PR numbers or exact titles, not API associations.
Default-branch commit search misses sessions with no commits and most work still sitting on unmerged branches.
Commit timestamps are preserved as returned by GitHub; date groupings in the article use the timestamp date in its own offset, mostly UTC-05.
Open pull requests can change after the snapshot; closed-unmerged branch commits may disappear if branches are deleted.
